name: magnetic-button
title: Industrial Magnetic Button
description: Hairline button that leans toward the pointer and sweeps a fill on hover. Button and link.

props.description: A native button. Extends every button prop.

props.name: variant
props.description: Surface treatment. All but ghost fill with clay on hover.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual height of 36, 44 or 56 px. The hit area is at least 44 px.

props.name: strength
props.description: Maximum pull in px, 0 to 24. 0 turns the magnet off.

props.name: index
props.description: Decorative mono index before the label.

props.name: type
props.description: Native button type. Defaults to button.
The same surface as an anchor.

variants.name: variant
variants.description: outline hairline, solid filled, accent clay, ghost borderless.

accessibility: A native button or anchor. Keyboard, focus and disabled come from the platform.
The hit area is at least 44 by 44 px at every size.
Label contrast on the fill is 4.5:1 or more.
Only mouse and pen pull the button. Touch never moves it.

animation.trigger: Pointer move, written as CSS variables
